Treatment summary
Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with a reported wrist fracture. The mechanism of injury is
consistent with the force described, and the findings fit the reported impact. Radiographs and the physical examination clearly
confirm a fracture of the wrist. No prior injury to this area is documented in the available history. Treatment has been intensive,
with 29 visits to date, most occurring on a near-daily basis. Over the course of care, the patient reported symptoms in additional
body regions, first noted several weeks after the collision. The visit frequency and the number of treated areas are well above
what is typically expected for an uncomplicated fracture of this type. Billing records reviewed to date show no duplicate or
repeated charges. Ongoing management includes immobilization, range-of-motion monitoring, and a reassessment of the wrist
and the newly reported areas at the next scheduled visit.
